Hello mercenary! Aishi and I are trying to understand how this C.A.S.S.I.E. system works. She knows a lot about systems, way more than I imagined. Well, anyway, all ISB personnel are busy holding the line in the facility, so I need you to restore part of the system so I can access the files.

Reactivate the facility's power and plant a device in the server blocks—specifically one near some boxes on the floor; it's more vulnerable. After that, just get out of there!
